## Problem Description

A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve.
Example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## CET Compatibility Notes

If applicable, note any CET/Lua 5.1 constraints that affect this feature:

- [ ] Compatible with Lua 5.1 (no goto, no __gc, no table.pack/unpack)
- [ ] Works with CET's sandboxed environment
- [ ] Handles load-order awareness (mods may load before/after)

## Use Case

Describe the use case or scenario where this feature would be useful:

- Which engine(s) does this affect? [ ] UI-Engine [ ] Config-Engine [ ] Both
- Which component(s)? [e.g., Theme, Components, Window, Events]

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
